source_points.meaning: dense K+V element payload or explicit padded page
KV tensor backing is allocated from full configured pool sizes at initialization

reporting_rule: For a complete gap-free GPU/group0 event ledger, multiply unique retained warmup-only full blocks by2359296 and label the result derived occupied KV-pool payload bytes. Divide by contemporaneous real-context full-block payload for the requested branch ratio; report partial context and retained-history denominators separately.
limitations: Saved records do not dump live tensor storage nbytes, CUDA allocation addresses, allocator padding, or allocator-reserved totals; exact physical allocator bytes are unmeasured.
Pinned source files are from the recorded vLLM revision; this check does not independently hash the installed GPU files against those sources.
The observed pool counts are from the two named parity epochs. Prefill starts a new engine epoch and its own cache_config_info/startup values must be saved and checked before reusing this conversion.
Warming occupies slots in an already allocated pool; occupied payload bytes are not incremental nvidia-smi memory or bytes newly malloced for that request.
Published full cache blocks omit active partial blocks, request block tables, metadata, graphs and other GPU memory. Block pool capacity may include reserved/null slots.
An event publication can repeat a prior logical block. Deduplicate by valid ancestry and process epoch, and account for removal/reset; event count alone is not physical occupancy.
This check does not establish evictions, latency impact, multi-worker behavior, or a causal effect of speculative_prefill.
